title: Provider Delete Reconciliation Store Topology Coverage
problem: A27 mutation-topology preflight covered A09/A16/A23/A24 but did not include the durable provider-delete reconciliation ledger introduced in A29-A34, so deployment inventory could omit a single-host-only mutation store.

scenarios.case: all five built-in file-backed mutation stores are present in explicit deployment inventory
reconciliation ledger under multi-host topology without shared authority
reconciliation ledger under multi-host topology with declared capabilities but no concrete store adapter
future shared adapter may pass only with complete shared-authority capability contract
topology snapshot includes reconciliation store and rejects multi-host for all current built-ins
required built-in store is removed from inventory

limitations: This is deployment-safety/preflight evidence only and does not establish product PARITY.
POSIX flock, atomic rename, A29-A34 application locks and ordering watermarks remain same-host mechanisms and are not distributed synchronization.
No real shared transactional backend or reconciliation-store adapter is implemented in A35.
HQ/App still owns the actual deployment entrypoint that must invoke or equivalently enforce this preflight.
The exact current Worker-branch full regression remains unobserved because A26 cannot run without an executable exact checkout or CI runner.
